assessments.reasoning: The set rationale differentiates both variable classes. The nested example shows that a new name created in the hook has hook scope, while updating an already-visible passage temporary changes the enclosing variable.

limitations: The temporary-variable rule here covers creation in passage or hook code. It leaves lambda scopes and the behavior of updates to a temporary already visible from an enclosing scope outside the claim.
